content:
incident-bot: P1 alert — Dedicated pool 'halcyon-prod' high 5xx rate (error spike ~30% over last 3m). Pager sent to oncall.
Priya (oncall): seeing it, pushing to #incidents. I’m digging into metrics now.
Sam (eng): I can pull the request logs, linking prometheus and logs.
Priya (oncall): thanks. quick question — is this only the halcyon tenant or affecting co-tenants in that dedicated pool?
Sam (eng): initial grep: errors are concentrated on tenant=halcyon. other tenants normal.
Jorge (sre): copying — if it's tenant-isolated that's good. sounds like artifact regression on pinned canary. any recent canary promotions?
Matt (eng-runtime): yeah we flipped canary -> staged yesterday at 02:10 UTC to artifact a1b2c3d. health checks passed but we're seeing increased decode timeouts 500-> up.
Priya (oncall): can we pin back to previous artifact quickly? what's the previous artifact id?
Matt (eng-runtime): prev was a1b2c3c (promotion 2026-03-10 12:40). Suggest pinning halcyon tenant back to a1b2c3c and isolating traffic on that dedicated pool while we investigate.
Priya (oncall): Linda, can you loop in Halcyon ops? need to communicate impact and plan.
Linda (CS): @Ava (Halcyon - Ops) — we’ve got a P1 impacting your prod traffic on dedicated pool; engineers are preparing a pinback and surgical isolation. ETA ~10-15m.
Ava (Halcyon - Ops): saw the page. Confirming customers seeing timeouts on some requests (esp. long-context). Please keep me posted — we need regression rollback asap.
Sam (eng): grabbing recent logs — stack traces point to tokenization/seq-length path hitting a new fastpath in a1b2c3d. Fallback failing for certain prompt shapes.
Jorge (sre): plan: 1) pin tenant to a1b2c3c (safe artifact) 2) isolate halcyon on a dedicated spare pool if pin doesn't immediately reduce errors 3) rollback canary promotion globally if we see broader risk.
Priya (oncall): ok. I'll start the pin. Matt, please provide the exact command.
Matt (eng-runtime): run the tenant pin CLI:  ```
# pin halcyon tenant back to previous artifact
redwoodctl tenant pin --tenant halcyon --artifact a1b2c3c --scope dedicated --reason "emergency rollback - 5xx spike"
```
Sam (eng): also recommend warming prefix cache after pin, run incremental restart on halcyon workers: ```
redwoodctl pool restart --pool halcyon-prod --rolling --wait-health
```
Priya (oncall): executing pin now.
deploy-bot: start: tenant-pin halcyon -> a1b2c3c (requested by Priya).
Priya (oncall): pin command returned SUCCESS. deploy-bot: done.
Sam (eng): I see traffic switching; error rate dropping from 32% -> 8% in the last 90s.
Jorge (sre): good. keep monitoring for 10m. if it doesn’t hit <2% we isolate traffic.
Ava (Halcyon - Ops): reporting to product team — seeing improved latency, some residual 503s but clearing. thanks.
Priya (oncall): rerunning health check and restarting worker group to ensure no stale kv runtime state: ```
redwoodctl worker restart --tenant halcyon --group core --grace 30s
```
Matt (eng-runtime): restart done. metrics look stable. QPS back to expected.
Linda (CS): customer on call is still connected, wants an ETA for full remediation and RCA.
Jorge (sre): immediate mitigation = pinback successful. Next steps: rollback canary promotion on global catalog, revert a1b2c3d from staged, and run controlled re-promote after fix. I'll own revert and rollout policy.
Priya (oncall): handing incident to Jorge for post-incident ops and RCA. Priya -> Jorge Handoff: all mitigation steps executed, pin confirmed, warm restarts performed.
Jorge (sre): acknowledged. will open outage ticket and set postmortem owner.
Jorge (sre): taking lead. initial impact: halcyon tenant ~30% 5xx for ~8 minutes before mitigation. no other tenants impacted. customer-facing summary will be drafted by Linda + Jorge.
Matt (eng-runtime): one action item: add a canary smoke test that exercises long-context tokenization shapes that triggered this. I'll add to runtime CI.
Sam (eng): raw logs snippet (errors): ```
[2026-03-14T14:05:21Z] ERROR decoder: buffer overflow while fastpath decode, prompt_len=16384, shard=3
[2026-03-14T14:05:22Z] ERROR request: 503 - tokenization error
```
Priya (oncall): marking incident as mitigated for now. leaving thread open until postmortem. :white_check_mark:
Ava (Halcyon - Ops): thanks all. please ping when RCA ready.
Linda (CS): I'll schedule a customer sync and share mitigation summary.
Jorge (sre): postmortem owner: Jorge (sre). timeline + root cause hypothesis: new artifact a1b2c3d introduced a tokenizer fastpath regression for long inputs under certain shard alignment. action items: revert canary, add smoke test, add alert signature for tokenization 5xx spike for single-tenant concentration.
Priya (oncall): closing handoff. will add incident timeline to ticket.
incident-bot: incident status changed: mitigated -> monitoring.
Jorge (sre): will set reminder for immediate follow-up meeting in 24h.
Linda (CS): customer confirmed service recovered. closing loop. :phone:
